fields.statement: At d82b495e ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/inbox-projects -count=1 (PASS): a root of two projects alpha and beta, each with one fixture run journal; rhiza inbox --json at the root lists both items with a project field each (alpha question, beta signoff), human output shows a project: line; inbox open of alpha's question from the root (and with --all from inside beta) focuses its tab through the fake rex; inbox approve of beta's sign-off from the root reaches beta's run SIGNOFFRUN01; from inside alpha, or with --project alpha/beta, only that project's item and no project field; unregistered --project and --project with --all are usage. Also passed every TestScripts/inbox* and tui-inbox script, describe-golden, and go test ./internal/api -run Inbox|inbox. Read the diff: inboxScopes picks the projects, mergeInbox tags and dedupes machine-wide items, findInboxItem returns the item's project ctx and approve/request-changes run in it.
